args: A container terminal at night from the quayside. Towering gantry cranes lift a shipping container; stacked container rows recede into haze. Faint blue holographic route lines and node markers float over the yard. Lit almost entirely in azure blue and deep royal blue, matching the reference palette exactly. Pale ice-blue highlights only. STRICTLY NO cyan, NO teal, NO turquoise, NO magenta, NO purple, NO pink, NO green, NO orange. Deep blue-black background, volumetric haze, shallow depth of field, anamorphic highlights, cinematic photoreal 3D render, 24mm lens. Absolutely no text, no lettering, no signage, no brand marks, no readable characters anywhere. No visible human faces.
